name: Jira Sync
description: Two-way sync between the board and a Jira project: pull tickets in via JQL, push status transitions and comments back. Zero-dependency REST client, fully offline self-testable against recorded fixtures.

skills.description: Resolve one outstanding sync conflict or failed push and re-run the half of sync that reports it resolved.

scripts.name: bootstrap
scripts.label: Bootstrap / check connection
scripts.description: Read-only: validates Jira credentials and site reachability without changing anything.

scripts.name: plan
scripts.label: Plan (dry run)
scripts.description: Prints what a pull would import/update, without writing anything.

scripts.name: selftest
scripts.label: Self-test (offline)
scripts.description: Exercises the whole client end-to-end against recorded fixtures. No network.

loops.name: sync-conflicts
loops.label: Sync conflicts & failed pushes
loops.description: One ticket per outstanding inbound-pull conflict or outbound-push failure, generated from the sync state pull/push already persist.

config.label: JQL filter
config.description: Restricts which issues sync. Defaults to "project = <projectKey> ORDER BY updated ASC" when omitted.

config.label: Default issue type
config.description: Jira issue type for issues created by push. Defaults to Task.

config.label: Create Jira issues from new board issues
config.description: Set to true to have push create a Jira issue for each new board issue without an external key. Off by default.

config.label: Sync direction
config.description: both | jira-to-board | board-to-jira, for the mapped fields (title, description, priority, type, labels). Empty = jira-to-board (no field edits are written to Jira); choose both to push board edits as well.

config.label: Per-field direction (JSON)
config.description: Optional override per field (values: both, jira-to-board, board-to-jira), e.g. {"description": "jira-to-board", "priority": "both"}. Fields: title, description, priority, type, labels.

config.label: Status map (JSON)
config.description: Optional override of board status to Jira status name, e.g. {"Done": "Fertig"}. Without it, board statuses match by Jira status category.

config.label: Pull every (min)
config.description: Scheduled pull interval in minutes. Empty or 0 = off.

config.label: Push every (min)
config.description: Scheduled push interval in minutes. Empty or 0 = off.
